model: RIBTW240xB-BC enclosed BACnet relay (1 relay, 1 input)
applies_to: Functional Devices RIBTW240xB-BC enclosed BACnet MS/TP relays with one relay output and one binary input.
summary: An enclosed BACnet MS/TP relay with one relay (BO1) and one binary input (BI1). Both objects are plain I/O with user-writable names; there is no on-board control logic.
notes: Object names are user-writable and the PICS prints no factory default name, so each object is listed by its printed ID (BI1, BO1...).
BO1 has a 16-level priority array and writable minimum on / off times (0-65535 s); polarity and active / inactive texts are writable on every object.

integration.summary: Write BO1 to switch the relay and read BI1 for the input.
setup: The PICS prints the device object ID default as DE277000 (vendor ID 277); it is writable.
MS/TP master; the PICS lists 9600-115200 baud. Max_Master defaults to 127.
